Today, Facebook reminded me of the [Operation Code](https://twitter.com/@operation_code) Launch Party held on [Thursday, April 16, 2015](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/operation-code-launch-party-tickets-16494832488?fbclid=IwAR3a3CK4pc8lZ71jAQVkUF6Odk-b9x74BzG79TT0Jg0P10EqSAwXyZlOjtM#) at [Epicodus code school](https://www.epicodus.com/blog). The event drew over 75 friends and family to downtown Portland, including representatives from all Portland-based code schools and Sen. Ron Wyden and Congressman Blumenauer's office. Since then Operation Code has grown nationally and internationally as a 501c(3).
